# Pull Request

> **The PR title must follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)**, e.g. `feat(asr): add VAD pre-filter` or `fix(tts): correct onnx voice path`. This is enforced locally by the `commitlint` pre-commit hook and in CI.

## 🚀 Description

Summary of changes and which issue this PR closes (preferably at most one).

## 🧪 Testing Proof

- [ ] `make check` passed (ruff lint + format).

## 🧹 Quality Check

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` passed.

## 📸 Visuals (Optional)

Attach screenshots of performance traces or demo output.
